health.not_a_benchmark_statement: Not a benchmark. No industry average, no pass mark, no comparison with any other organisation. The only useful comparison is against the same meeting, or the same type of meeting, scored at a different time.

partial_scoring.below_floor: score null, label 'Not scored. The record does not support assessment.', show scoreable dimensions without a total

anchors.0: no purpose or objective stated; began with a topic
anchors.1: a topic was named; no output, decision or outcome specified
anchors.2: purpose stated but required output or decision left implicit
anchors.3: one sentence purpose naming the decision or output, and the meeting worked to it

anchors.0: multiple participants made no contribution with no evident reason
anchors.1: several contributed only to a small part with no partial attendance arrangement
anchors.2: most contributed to the output; one or two did not
anchors.3: every participant contributed or their presence was explicitly justified

dimensions.name: Decision Quality

anchors.0: decisions needed and none made, or too vague to record
anchors.1: decisions made without owner, rationale or clear wording
anchors.2: decisions stated clearly with owners; rationale or rejected options missing
anchors.3: confirmed aloud with owner, rationale, rejected options, conditions and review date where provisional

dimensions.modifier: objective in (explore, learn, diagnose): re-anchor to whether the next decision was identified and assigned; absence of closure does not score 0

anchors.0: actions with no owner, or no actions where the meeting required them
anchors.1: actions have owners; most lack dates or a definition of done
anchors.2: most carry owner, verb, object and date; confirmation or definition of done missing
anchors.3: every action carries all five fields and each owner confirmed it in the meeting

dimensions.name: Time Efficiency

anchors.0: no structure, substantial unrelated time, ran over with work unfinished
anchors.1: loose structure, significant drift or one item consuming disproportionate time
anchors.2: structured and broadly to time; some drift or a rushed close
anchors.3: time boxed, sequenced, held to the questions, closed with the recap inside the meeting

dimensions.unscoreable_when: duration unknown and record not time stamped

anchors.0: one voice dominant throughout; no questions or challenge
anchors.1: two or three voices; others only when directly addressed
anchors.2: broad contribution with some imbalance, or challenge only from senior participants
anchors.3: contribution spread, with questions and at least one genuine challenge or dissent recorded

dimensions.name: Risk Identification

anchors.0: material commitments made with no risk or failure mode raised
anchors.1: risks mentioned in passing; none owned, rated or mitigated
anchors.2: risks raised and discussed; some lack owner, mitigation or trigger
anchors.3: risks raised, characterised as stated, owned, with mitigations and escalation triggers

dimensions.modifier: scored relative to what the meeting committed to; a meeting that committed to nothing is not scored 0

dimensions.name: Opportunity Identification

anchors.0: purely reactive; no forward consideration where the type invites it
anchors.1: opportunities mentioned without development or ownership
anchors.2: identified and discussed but not prioritised or assigned
anchors.3: identified, assessed against stated criteria, and assigned a next step

dimensions.unscoreable_when: type in (MT-B05, MT-B06, MT-D07) or restricted

anchors.0: no connection made between decisions and any stated objective, plan or priority
anchors.1: alignment referenced in passing without specifics
anchors.2: decisions connected to stated objectives for some items
anchors.3: decisions and priorities explicitly tested against stated objectives, including trade offs

dimensions.name: Outcome Quality

anchors.0: produced nothing that exists now and did not before
anchors.1: discussion occurred; the output is shared understanding with no artefact
anchors.2: real output produced; distribution, recording or closure incomplete
anchors.3: stated output produced, confirmed aloud, record and follow up set in motion

dimensions.modifier: follow up timing component scored only where the workspace can observe the send
